name: Giant Weasel
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored rules text, read in a text mirror
heading: Giant weasel Traits
sourceDistinctions: The player trait block sets walking speed at 35 ft. The design discussion mentions 40 ft. The build uses 35 ft. before class movement.
The v2 monk clarification on p. 7 makes bonus strikes from Martial Arts and Flurry of Blows ordinary bludgeoning strikes. The action bite retains its own damage.
The Weasel block later in the book is a different playable profile.

name: Giant Wolf Spider
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored rules text, read in a text mirror
heading: Giant Wolf Spider Traits
sourceDistinctions: The wolf spider has no Web action. Its printed poison is additional damage with no saving throw.
The play example assigns Sneak Attack dice to the bite’s piercing component. The printed bite already qualifies as finesse.

name: Hawk
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored rules text, read in a text mirror
heading: Hawk Traits
sourceDistinctions: The trait block gives 60-ft. flight. The design discussion mentions 50 ft. The build uses the printed trait.
The Tiny weapon table on p. 8 resizes equipment. It does not replace the hawk’s printed natural talon die. Tiny carrying capacity is one quarter of the equivalent Small or Medium value.
Blood Hawk has its own published trait block.

name: Hunter Shark
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored rules text, read in a text mirror
heading: Hunter Shark Traits
sourceDistinctions: The Hunter Shark trait line for size is blank. Its own design notes on p. 249 specify the reduction from Large to Medium. This play example uses Medium.
The design notes mention natural weapon finesse, but the printed Bite trait has no finesse. This build uses Strength.
The Giant Shark entry on p. 244 redirects to Hunter Shark’s player traits. Retain one profile, one NPC in the base form and one portrait.

name: Jackal
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored rules text, read in a text mirror
heading: Jackal Traits
sourceDistinctions: This playable bite deals slashing. Keen Hearing and Smell are discussed in the design notes but omitted from the published trait block.
Jackalwere has its own trait block and is a separate playable profile.
